validation_checks: Exactly 16 designs times 2 parameters are reported.
Each cell contains n=250 paired replicates and a finite median with a 95% bootstrap interval.
Parameter-specific coverage and calibration success are present.
Local and distant starting regimes are separated.
Parameter-specific errors are reported for every selected strategy.
Paired comparisons use shared replicate identifiers and bootstrap intervals.
Production PHREEQC calculations are finite and non-penalty outputs.
Data-only single- and multi-time designs report sensitivity collinearity and numerical rank.
The independent surface-area observation restores numerical rank two.
Balanced 2x2 layout with readable labels and units.
Panels distinguish predicted local information from realised recovery.
Kinetic structural evidence is labelled as a controlled synthetic result.
The 240-cell numerical truth passes the locked comparison with the 480-cell reference.
E-optimal, development-oracle, random, and no-new strategies contain 250 locked test replicates.
The active-learning row is explicitly not applicable when no transport-time action is emitted.
Parameter-specific differences are paired by replicate.
Each interval uses 5,000 bootstrap resamples.
The decision rule is applied separately to dispersivity and decay.
Every strategy contains the same 24 untouched independent aquifer cases.
Candidate recall, actionability, Brier score, PR-AUC, log loss, information per cost, resource cost, and action count are finite.
The interpretation distinguishes superiority to random from noninferiority to the strong legacy policy.
All proposed-versus-comparator contrasts are paired by aquifer case.
Each interval uses 5,000 deterministic bootstrap resamples.
The frozen superiority, noninferiority, non-harm, recall, and actionability gates are applied without post-test changes.
